name: Fountain pen [万年筆]
definition: pen that feeds liquid ink from a reservoir to a split nib; filling system, nib size, shape and material and body material are attributes.
notes: JetPens Fountain Pens category lists 2,831 items; 18 types incl. cartridge, piston, vacuum filling

name: Dip pen (nib holder and nibs)
definition: holder with loose nibs dipped in a separate bottle of ink; a dip pen or nib whose maker names comics or drawing only is C4.
notes: JetPens Dip Pens: types calligraphy, glass, nib holders, nibs; page sells holders and loose nibs

name: Ballpoint pen [ボールペン]
definition: pen that rolls viscous oil-based ink onto paper through a ball tip; a digital pen that writes in ink and records it carries `recording`.
notes: JetPens: ballpoint means oil-based ink only; gel and rollerball separate

name: Gel pen
definition: ball-tip pen with water-based gel ink.
notes: JetPens Gel Pens: 1,972 items; erasable and archival gel types

name: Rollerball pen
definition: ball-tip pen with liquid water-based ink; a recording digital pen of this type carries `recording`.
notes: JetPens: rollerball means liquid-ink ball pens; cartridge and refillable types

name: Multi pen
definition: one barrel holding several ball or gel refills (and sometimes a pencil) selected in turn.
notes: JetPens Multi Pens: 2 to 5 component, ink plus pencil combinations

name: Felt-tip pen (fineliner)
definition: fine fibre-tip pen made for writing, or for writing and drawing both.
notes: JetPens Fineliners type (831 items) under Markers & Felt Tip Pens

name: Marker pen
definition: broad fibre or felt-tip pen for marking and labelling.
notes: JetPens Markers & Felt Tip Pens: permanent, dry erase, paint types

name: Highlighter [蛍光ペン]
definition: broad-tip pen with translucent fluorescent ink for marking text.
notes: JetPens Highlighters: double-sided, erasable, pastel, neon types

name: Brush pen
definition: pen with a flexible brush tip whose maker names handwriting, lettering or calligraphy first or both (a fudepen is here); drawing-only brush pens are C4.
notes: JetPens Brush Pens: Calligraphy Brush Pens type (272 items), pocket brush pens

name: Calligraphy brush (shodo brush)
definition: hair brush made for East Asian calligraphy.
notes: Kyoto Handicraft Center sells Japanese Calligraphy Writing Brush items in a Calligraphy Sets collection

name: Ink stick
definition: solid stick of soot and binder ground on an inkstone to make calligraphy ink.
notes: Retailer page sells Kuretake sumi ink sticks ground by hand for calligraphers

name: Inkstone
definition: stone slab with a well on which an ink stick is ground with water.
notes: JetPens Inkstones category: Yasutomo and Kuretake suzuri

name: Calligraphy set
definition: brush, ink and inkstone sold and compared as one kit (S3a).
notes: Kyoto Handicraft Center Calligraphy Sets (3); page defines set as brush, ink, inkstone, paper

name: Wooden pencil (wood-cased)
definition: graphite core cased in wood, sharpened to use.
notes: JetPens Wooden Pencils: 672 items; writing pencils type

name: Mechanical pencil [シャープペンシル]
definition: refillable holder that advances a thin lead by a mechanism.
notes: JetPens Mechanical Pencils: 947 items; lead guard, rotating, thin lead types

name: Eraser
definition: block of rubber or plastic that rubs out pencil or ink marks.
notes: JetPens Erasers: block, kneaded, retractable, electric types

name: Correction tape
definition: dispenser that lays a dry white film over a written mark.
notes: JetPens Correction Tapes type (59 items) under Correction Products

name: Correction fluid
definition: quick-drying white liquid brushed or penned over a written mark.
notes: Hunt Office sells Tipp-Ex Rapid correction fluid bottle under Tippex & Correction Fluid category

name: Pencil sharpener
definition: device that sharpens a wooden pencil; `drive` (manual, electric) is an attribute of the one kind.
notes: JetPens Pencil Sharpeners (58 items); manual, brake and brass types

name: Notebook
definition: bound book of blank, lined, dot or graph sheets for notes ("journal" is an alias); size, ruling, binding, paper stock and `reusable` are attributes.
notes: JetPens Notebooks 1,409 items; Journals listed separately (alias)

name: Composition book
definition: sewn notebook with a stiff marbled-style board cover and lined pages.
notes: JetPens Composition Notebooks type; Quill Composition Notebooks category sells Mead Five Star marble book

name: Refillable notebook system
definition: cover plus refill books sold together as one system (TRAVELER'S notebook is a named form); covers and refills sold separately are C5.5.5.
notes: JetPens sells TRAVELER'S notebook Starter Kit with covers and refill books as a system

name: Diary / planner [手帳, techo]
definition: bound book ruled by date or for dates (daily, weekly, monthly), dated or undated; Hobonichi Techo is a named form.
notes: JetPens Planners: daily, weekly, monthly, dated and undated; Hobonichi Techo

name: Calendar
definition: printed sheets of the days, weeks or months of a year; `format` (wall, desk, pocket) is an attribute.
notes: Staples sells AT-A-GLANCE monthly wall calendar; Calendar Type Wall

name: Sticky-note calendar [ひめくり, himekuri]
definition: tear-off or sticky-note day calendar, one sheet per day (level provisional, C11).
notes: JetPens Himekuri Sticky Note Calendars category with undated himekuri calendar

name: Loose-leaf paper
definition: punched loose sheets made for a binder.
notes: JetPens Loose Leaf Paper: binder paper and paper packs, punched

name: Memo pad
definition: glued or bound pad of tear-off sheets for short notes.
notes: JetPens Memo Notepads 271 items; MD Memo Block, Rhodia DotPad

name: Sticky notes
definition: pad of small sheets with a repositionable adhesive strip ("adhesive notes" in Australia).
notes: JetPens Sticky Notes 661 items; small, large, film, page markers

name: Letter-writing paper set
definition: writing sheets sold with matching envelopes for letters ("letter set").
notes: JetPens Stationery Paper has Letter Sets type with matching envelopes

name: Copy and printer paper
definition: plain cut sheets sold by the ream for copiers and printers (K-158; photographic paper is D4).
notes: Hunt Office Premium Paper category: A4 reams of 500 sheets (Xerox Premier, Navigator)

name: Envelope
definition: folded paper cover for posting a letter or document (K-193).
notes: JetPens Stationery Paper has Envelopes type (21 items)

name: Padded envelope
definition: envelope lined with bubble or paper padding for posting small items (K-193).
notes: Mailcoms sells Paper Padded Envelopes / Mailers, product type Padded Envelopes

name: Mailing tube
definition: rigid tube for posting rolled documents (K-193).
notes: Mailcoms Postal Tubes: cardboard tubes for posting rolled documents and posters

name: Greeting card
definition: folded printed card with envelope, sold blank inside or with a message, to be written and sent.
notes: Quill Greeting Cards category: Better Office Hello Cards blank inside, with envelopes

name: Gift wrap
definition: printed or decorated paper sold for wrapping presents.
notes: American Retail Supply Bulk Wrapping Paper category: gift wrap rolls by style

name: Sticker sheet
definition: sheet of printed self-adhesive stickers sold as stationery (a collectible sticker series is F3).
notes: JetPens sells Midori Planner Stickers, a sheet of 110 removable stickers
